expires_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC time after which the upload URL is refused.

headers.description: Headers to send with the upload (`content-type`).

upload_url.description: Send the photo bytes here once, before `expires_at`.

phone.description: Trimmed; 8-15 digits starting 1-9 get a leading `+`; then strict E.164.

invites.description: Processed in array order, in one transaction. Not an array → `invalid_invites`.

created.description: New rows (`resent: false`) and refreshed expired/declined rows (`resent: true`).

owner_name.description: The owner row's stored display name.

pending_count.description: Valid pending invites only: not canceled, not consumed, not expired.

avatar_url.description: Public URL of the row user's profile photo (`{SUPABASE_URL}/storage/v1/object/public/avatars/{path}`); null without a user or photo.

display_name.description: Active rows with a user: that user's current profile name (trimmed), else the stored name. Other rows: the stored invite name.

owner_name.description: The owner row's stored display name.

device_name.description: Shown in the session list, e.g. "Pixel 8". Optional.

purpose.description: `signup` (default): a new confirmation link; `magic_link`: a sign-in link.

token.description: The `token` query value of the emailed link.

allergies.description: Ignored since SCRUM-21 (D51): use `POST /v1/me/profile/allergies` and its item routes.

emergency_contact_email.description: An email address (`profiles:invalid_email`). Trimmed; blank or left out is stored as null.

emergency_contact_phone.description: Strict E.164 after trimming: `^\+[1-9][0-9]{7,14}$` (`profiles:invalid_phone`). The server adds no country code.

emergency_notes.description: At most 500 characters (`profiles:emergency_notes_too_long`). Trimmed; blank or left out is stored as null.

emergency_preferred_language.description: Free text. Trimmed; blank or left out is stored as null.

medical_conditions.description: Ignored since SCRUM-21 (D51): use `POST /v1/me/profile/medical-conditions` and its item routes.

share_phone.description: Share the account's confirmed phone with the members of an alert (SCRUM-52, D59). Left out keeps the stored value (on by default).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region the numbers are for (V1: `GM`).

emergency_services.description: The local emergency numbers of the incident's region (SCRUM-54, D60), always in the order ambulance, police, fire_rescue; a service without a number is left out; `[]` when the region has none configured.

label.description: What to show, e.g. `Ambulance`, `Fire and Rescue`.

number.description: The number to dial, digits only (an optional leading `+`), e.g. `116`. Confirm before dialing.

service.description: Which service. Clients show unknown future values as a plain number.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The body of every non-2xx response (spec §11.2).

closed_at.description: SCRUM-63 (D61): when the incident became Closed (final, read-only); null until then. With status closed: resolved_reason safe = closed after the wrap-up following mark safe; ended with auto_closed true = closed automatically after inactivity.

emergency_services.description: The local emergency numbers of the incident's region (SCRUM-54, D60), always in the order ambulance, police, fire_rescue; a service without a number is left out; `[]` when the region has none configured.

resident_name.description: The resident's full name; empty string when unknown.

share_payload.description: The LIVE shared info (SCRUM-21, D53): the latest shared fields when they changed them during the incident, else the activation snapshot; `{}` when none. Allergies / conditions: arrays of strings (a single string in older incidents).

share_payload_at_activation.description: What was shared at activation (what the alerts carried); never changes. `{}` when none.

share_payload_updated_at.description: When the resident last changed the shared info during the incident; null = unchanged since activation.

actor_id.description: Who caused the event (null when no user did). The resident of the incident gets the full UUID. Any other caller gets it obscured: the first 4 and the last 4 hex characters are kept, every other hex character is replaced by "*", and the hyphens and 36-character shape stay (e.g. "4f3a****-****-****-****-********9c2d"), unless the actor is the caller, whose own id is always shown in full. Not a usable UUID when obscured.

actor_name.description: D71: the display name of the actor, the same for every caller (show it instead of any id); null when actor_id is null. A member: their profile name (trimmed), else the name on their membership, as the responder list. The resident: their profile name (trimmed). Empty when no name is known.

event_type.description: See spec §5.6: alert_sent, renotified, location_sharing_started, location_sharing_ended, safe_recorded, incident_closed, closure_notified, status_update (D70: detail {preset} or {text}), responder_acknowledged (D71: a member acknowledged, detail {}) and responder_status (D71: a member changed their response, detail {status: "responding" | "unable"}).

closed_at.description: SCRUM-63 (D61): when the incident became Closed; always null on the live bodies (only an active incident is open, re-notified or submitted; resolved and closed incidents never block a new SOS).

emergency_services.description: The local emergency numbers of the incident's region (SCRUM-54, D60), always in the order ambulance, police, fire_rescue; a service without a number is left out; `[]` when the region has none configured.

anyOf.description: Shared fields by key. Keys not shared are left out.

status.description: "responding" (I am responding) or "unable" (unable to respond). Anything else is 422 incident_response:invalid_status.

created_at.description: When the server stored the update.

preset.description: The quick update, or null for a free-text update.

text.description: The free text (trimmed), or null for a quick update.

invite_token.description: Only while `pending` (to accept or decline); null otherwise.

owner_avatar_url.description: SCRUM-33: the inviting circle owner's public avatar URL (the same rule as the preview's `owner_avatar_url`), or null when they have no photo.

owner_name.description: The owner row's stored display name.

status.description: The lookup status (spec §5.3). Accepted (`consumed`) invitations are not listed.

invite_expires_at.description: Null when the token is not found.

circle_id.description: Only when the row is shown.

claimed.description: True when the invitation is (now) bound to the caller. Null where the SQL function returns null (e.g. the owner previewing an unclaimed invitation).

invited_at.description: Only when the row is shown.

member_id.description: Only when the row is shown.

owner_avatar_url.description: Only when the owner is shown: the owner's public avatar URL, or null.

owner_name.description: Only when the owner is shown: the owner row's stored display name.

recipient_ok.description: The caller may accept this invitation (spec rule 18).

status.description: Lookup status, or the display statuses `own_circle`, `already_member`, `circle_full`.

active_incident_id.description: SCRUM-81: the newest active incident of this circle that the caller may open, else null. On a `member` row: an alert the caller received (started after they joined, while still a member); on the own `owner` row: the caller's own active alert (they are its resident). A member opens it with `GET /v1/incidents/{id}`; the owner with `GET /v1/me/incidents/open`.

active_member_count.description: Active members of the circle, owner excluded (pending and declined excluded).

capacity_used.description: Gap 20 (D50): slots used in this circle, owner excluded: active members + valid pending invitations (not canceled, not consumed, not expired); the same number as Capacity `used` on the owner screen. For "Members (n of 5)" in the Member View. A count only.

member_id.description: The caller's member row in that circle.

owner_name.description: The owner row's stored display name.

role.description: `owner` for the circle the caller owns (it is listed too, as today).

test_alert.description: Null when the caller never sent a test alert.

member_id.description: The caller's member row, now ended (kept as history, status `left`).

interval_seconds.description: Seconds between location uploads while an alert is active (default 12).

stale_threshold_seconds.description: A fix older than this many seconds is shown as stale (default 45).

text.description: 1-100 characters, trimmed (an item from the old free text may be longer).

updated_at.description: When the item was added or last edited.

text.description: Trimmed; 1-100 characters (`profiles:invalid_medical_item`); not the same as another item of the list, ignoring case (`profiles:duplicate_medical_item`).

invite_token.description: 64 lowercase hex characters; single use; 7-day expiry.

resent.description: True when an existing row was refreshed (same `member_id`).

created_at.description: When the owner sent the test (UTC).

is_test.description: Always true: a test, never an emergency.

owner_name.description: The circle owner current profile name (trimmed); null when blank.

seen_at.description: When the caller opened it; null until then.

is_new_user.description: True when this sign-in created the account.

refresh_token.description: Opaque, single use: every refresh returns a new one. Keep it in secure storage.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: Refresh before this: a session not refreshed for 7 days ends (sign in again).

purpose.description: `sign_in` (no access token) or `verify_phone` (the signed-in user's own number; send the access token).

refresh_token.description: Opaque, single use: every refresh returns a new one. Keep it in secure storage.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: Refresh before this: a session not refreshed for 7 days ends (sign in again).

capacity.description: Null when the caller owns no circle.

circle.description: Null when the caller owns no circle.

members.description: Owner view of the member list (owner row first); empty when there is no circle.

token.description: The `token` query value of the emailed recovery link.

avatar_path.description: Null clears it; left out keeps the stored value. Else an object path in the caller's own folder: `{uid}/<name>` (`profiles:invalid_avatar_path`).

date_of_birth.description: `YYYY-MM-DD`, a real date not after today (Africa/Banjul = UTC) (`profiles:invalid_date_of_birth`).

gender.description: Null clears it; left out keeps the stored value (null on a new profile).

expires_in_seconds.description: Lifetime of the texted code (600 s).

phone.description: The new number of the pending change.

anyOf.description: Spec §4.4: one of the 7 relationship values.

relationship.description: Null or blank: none (an existing row keeps its own). Else one of the 7 values.

allergies.description: The allergy items joined with ", " (kept for old readers); use `allergy_items`.

avatar_path.description: Object path in the `avatars` bucket, e.g. `{uid}/avatar-{uuid}.jpg`.

avatar_url.description: Public URL of `avatar_path`: `{SUPABASE_URL}/storage/v1/object/public/avatars/{avatar_path}`; null without a photo.

emergency_info_completed_at.description: Set by the server the first time Emergency Info is saved; never reset.

medical_condition_items.description: The medical conditions, oldest first (SCRUM-21, D51).

medical_conditions.description: The medical-condition items joined with ", " (kept for old readers); use `medical_condition_items`.

medical_info_updated_at.description: When the medical info last changed: an allergy or condition added, edited or deleted, or the blood type changed (SCRUM-21). Null before the first change.

personal_info_completed_at.description: Set by the server the first time Personal Info is saved; never reset.

preferences_completed_at.description: Set by the server the first time Preferences are saved; never reset.

share_phone.description: Share my phone number (SCRUM-52, D59): when on, members of an alert get the account's confirmed phone as `resident_phone` in the shared info. On by default.

circle_id.description: Null while location sharing is off (no circle yet).

member_status.description: The contact row's stored status: `declined` when it was left unchanged because the circle is full.

PushTokenStatus.description: `ok`: a push token is stored for this installation. `none`: no token is stored. `invalid`: the token sent is the one the push provider last rejected as unregistered for this installation; it was not stored, and the app must get a brand-new token and register again (D69).

closed_at.description: SCRUM-63 (D61): when the incident became Closed (final, read-only); null until then. With status closed: resolved_reason safe = closed after the wrap-up following mark safe; ended with auto_closed true = closed automatically after inactivity.

push_provider.description: Who issued `push_token`: `fcm` or `apns`. Sent together with `push_token`.

push_token.description: The device push token. Left out (with `push_provider`): the stored token is kept. `null`: the stored token is cleared. A token is on one device only: registering it here clears it from any other device.

acknowledged_at.description: When the member acknowledged (also set by their first response); null if not.

avatar_url.description: Public URL of the member's profile photo, as in the circle member list; null without one.

display_name.description: The member's profile name (trimmed), else the name stored on their membership.

is_me.description: True on the caller's own row.

status.description: responding / unable: the member's response; acknowledged: seen, no response yet; no_response: not acknowledged.

status_at.description: When the current status was set: the response time for responding / unable, the acknowledge time for acknowledged, null for no_response.

user_id.description: The member. The resident gets the full UUID. A member gets the ids of other members obscured as incident event actor ids (D11): the first 4 and the last 4 hex characters kept, every other hex character "*", hyphens kept (e.g. "4f3a****-****-****-****-********9c2d"); their own id in full. Not a usable UUID when obscured.

closed_at.description: SCRUM-63 (D61): when the incident became Closed (final, read-only); null until then. With status closed: resolved_reason safe = closed after the wrap-up following mark safe; ended with auto_closed true = closed automatically after inactivity.

resident_name.description: The resident's full name; empty string when unknown.

preset.description: A quick update: "situation_worsening" (Situation worsening) or "help_is_here" (Help is here). Give exactly one of preset or text (null counts as not given); else 422 incident_updates:invalid_update.

text.description: A free-text update: trimmed of white space, then 1 to 250 characters. Give exactly one of preset or text; else 422 incident_updates:invalid_update.

refresh_token.description: Opaque, single use: every refresh returns a new one. Keep it in secure storage.

refresh_token_expires_at.description: Refresh before this: a session not refreshed for 7 days ends (sign in again).

object_path.description: An uploaded object in the caller's own folder (`{uid}/...`), or null to remove the photo.

incident_notes.description: Trimmed of spaces; empty or only spaces clears the note (null). At most 250 characters after trimming, else 422 set_incident_notes:too_long.

phone.description: `+E.164`; stored unverified (verify it with the OTP routes).

delivered_at.description: When the push provider first accepted it for one of the member devices.

display_name.description: The member current profile name (trimmed), else the name on their member row.

seen_at.description: When the member opened it in Atlas.

recipient_count.description: How many active members it was sent to (pending members are never included).

delivered_count.description: Members whose push the provider accepted.

pending_count.description: Per member, exclusive: the four counts add up to `recipient_count`.

recipients.description: Every recipient, by name. `status`: `pending` (not sent yet or being retried), `delivered` (the push provider accepted it), `seen` (the member opened it in Atlas), `failed` (see `failure_reason`).

seen_count.description: Members who opened it in Atlas.

incident.join.note: Allowed for the resident, or a member passing incident.memberView inside the membership window; re-checked on every join.

auth.token: <access token, the same as the REST bearer token>

handshake.note: Missing, invalid or expired token: connect_error with message and data.code "auth:session_expired". The server disconnects the socket at the token's exp (after "session.expired"); reconnect with a fresh token.

x-realtime.reconnect: Events are never replayed and rooms are not restored: after any (re)connect the client re-fetches over REST (open incident, delivery counts, details) and joins its incidents again.

circle.membership_ended.note: Sent after the commit, right after the sockets left the incident rooms of that circle (D20). No reason and no names: screens of that circle show the neutral "no longer available" state.
circle.membership_ended.room: user:{id} of the member who was removed or left (all their sockets; D49)

circle.test_alert.note: SCRUM-35 (D67): sent by the API right after the circle owner sent a test alert (POST /v1/me/circle/test-alerts). Show the TEST ALERT — NOT AN EMERGENCY banner and open GET /v1/test-alerts/{test_alert_id}; never an SOS, never an incident. occurred_at = created_at (the send time). Pending, declined, removed or left members and outsiders never get it. Not replayed after a reconnect.
circle.test_alert.room: user:{id} of each recipient of the test alert (the active members of the circle when it was sent)

incident.closed.note: SCRUM-63 (D61, D62): sent after the close sweeper (worker, once a minute) closed the incident: Resolved (Safe) -> Closed after the wrap-up (resolved_reason "safe", auto_closed false), or Active -> Closed after the inactivity period (resolved_reason "ended", auto_closed true: "Closed automatically"). status is "closed"; the incident is final and read-only. No push, SMS or email is sent at the close. Followed by incident.updated and incident.event in the incident room.
incident.closed.room: incident:{id}, user:{id} of each delivery recipient and user:{resident_id} (as incident.resolved; once per socket)

incident.event.note: One per inserted incident_events row, as GET /v1/incidents/{id}/events shows it to that receiver. actor_name (D71) is the display name of the actor (null when actor_id is null), the same for every receiver: show it instead of any id. SCRUM-60/61 (D71) event types responder_acknowledged (detail {}) and responder_status (detail {status: "responding" | "unable"}) are sent when a member acknowledges or changes their response; no push.
incident.event.room: incident:{id} (per receiver: recipient_ids only for the resident, actor_id masked for others except their own id)

incident.renotified.room: incident:{id} and user:{id} of each delivery recipient

incident.resolved.room: incident:{id}, user:{id} of each delivery recipient and user:{resident_id} (D48; once per socket)

incident.responders.note: SCRUM-49/50/51/55 (D56): sent after a member acknowledged for the first time or set or changed their response (responding / unable). responder is the row of that member exactly as GET /v1/incidents/{id}/responders shows it to the receiver; replace the row with the same user_id (the masked id is stable per member). Not sent for a repeat that changed nothing. After a reconnect, re-fetch the list over REST.
incident.responders.room: incident:{id} (per receiver: user_id in full for the resident and for the member whose row it is, masked as incident.event actor_id for other members)

incident.shared_info_updated.note: SCRUM-21 (D53): sent after the resident changed their shared emergency info during an active incident. share_payload is the live view (only what is shared now; allergies and medical_conditions are arrays of strings); updated_at = when it last changed (live_share_updated_at). The activation snapshot never changes. SCRUM-52 (D59): turning share_phone on or off adds or removes resident_phone here.

incident.update.note: SCRUM-44/59 (D70): sent after the resident sent a status update (POST /v1/incidents/{id}/updates), right after its incident.event (event_type "status_update"). update is the entry exactly as GET /v1/incidents/{id}/updates shows it: preset "situation_worsening" or "help_is_here" with text null, or text with preset null; created_at = occurred_at. No id of a person. Members also get a push (topic incident.status_update). After a reconnect, re-fetch the list over REST.

x-realtime.transport: Socket.IO 4 (Engine.IO 4), websocket only, on the API host
